question: Does replaying 80-document audit scores reproduce the top-3 an API reranker returns when it is sent only the retriever's top-10 documents?

sample.definition: 2 pools per retained occupation, seeded (seed 20260822); per occupation the template styles and query phrasings are drawn without replacement; identical pools for every model

method.retriever: BAAI/bge-large-en-v1.5 cached scores; top-10 per pool by the simulation's ordering rule (no retriever ties in any pool)
method.request: exactly the 10 retrieved documents, in retriever-rank order, one request per pool, query text as in the audit
method.replay: banked single-stage scores (80-document requests) for the same 10 documents
method.top3_share: compounding_experiment.analyse_slate, pipe_top3_m, seeded random tie-breaks averaged over 200 draws; the replay and live arms share the seed and therefore every tie-break draw
method.identical_top3_set: share of tie-break draws (shared between arms) in which the two top-3 sets coincide, averaged over pools
method.paired_diff: mean over pools of (live - replay) male-associated % of the top-3
method.bootstrap: occupation-clustered, occupations resampled within stereotype category, B=2000, percentile 95% CI
method.scale_match: live-on-banked linear fit slope in [0.8, 1.25], Pearson r >= 0.9, medians within 10% of the banked range; mean_abs_score_diff is reported only when true
